limits: 600 game ticks is nominally30seconds at20TPS, not a wall-clock guarantee.
The five-kill route tracks distinct Java classes; repeated kills of one class do not add distinct progress.
Shrine gate200 and delta-20 differ; shared Holy Sword multiplier also applies to negative deltas.
World-change and player-death reset callbacks mean prior tribute must not be assumed to carry over.
Ignored spawnEntity return is an acceptance-test target, not a reproduced failed-spawn report.
Provider placement/interaction restrictions must be considered together; a torch exception in one helper is not an independently verified placement guarantee.
